يشهاب (form XI)
# يَشْهَابُّ (yašhābbu) /jaʃ.haːb.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# يَشْهَابَّ (yašhābba) /jaʃ.haːb.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
# يَشْهَابِّ (yašhābbi) /jaʃ.haːb.bi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِشْهَابَّ (išhābba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
